name: zrndr_span_occlusion_insert_span_node_local
description: zRndr_SpanOcclusion::InsertSpanNodeIntoColumn inserts the pending span into one occlusion column, splits visible ranges around existing spans, appends visible outputs, and advances the span pool cursor.
known_limits: Binary Ninja keeps a limited reconstruction marker because ESP-relative depth-extrema scratch slots still alias with spanCount in HLIL, and the accepted depth-order helper call still displays a stale x87 tuple.

VC5SP3 byte comparison remains blocked after expanding the collapsed wrapper into an insertion body: 0x490ae0 now fails with 1822 unmasked mismatches after 124 relocation-masked bytes and 14 trimmed VC NOPs; BN size 1971, VC5 size 832.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x490ae0 validates the fastcall spanList and column-index arguments, stack spanCount parameter, lookup through the span-column head table, pending span insertion into empty and non-empty column lists, cheap depth-extrema rejection before the TestSpanDepthOrderPair call, visible span splitting/trimming, visible output coalescing, and g_spanAllocCursor advancement.

The native insert-local smoke verifies empty-column insertion, replacement of an occluded interior span, splitting a visible span around an occluder, full occlusion without cursor advancement, output span count writes, column head updates, and visible span array contents.
